about: The strategy catalog for CES. SKILL.md stage 5 (select) compares these entries against the real task and records the closest match; workflow.py validates this file, resolves the chosen id, and applies rubric_emphasis multipliers to the default weights in rubric.md when scoring. min_complexity is the lowest task class where the strategy earns its cost: small tasks follow the plain lifecycle in SKILL.md instead. Edit freely; keep ids unique and run: python3 workflow.py validate

strategies.name: Focused change
strategies.matches: A small, well-understood edit: one function, one message, one configuration value, a copy change, a single handler tweak.
when: the change is contained to one or two files
behavior and interfaces are already understood
no data, schema or public contract moves

stage_focus.inspect: Read only the code on the change path plus its direct callers.
stage_focus.verify: Run the most relevant existing check; add a regression test only for a real bug fix.

verify: the smallest relevant existing check passes
nothing outside the requested scope changed

strategies.name: Bug investigation
strategies.matches: Something behaves wrongly: an error, a crash, wrong output, a regression after an update, an intermittent failure.
when: the report describes actual behavior that differs from expected behavior
there is a symptom but no confirmed cause yet
logs, stack traces or failing tests exist

stage_focus.diagnose: Reproduce first and trace the complete execution path to the first evidenced divergence. Separate facts from hypotheses. Keep an attempt ledger; after two unsuccessful fixes, stop patching, reject failed assumptions and widen the investigation across callers, async/concurrency, state, configuration, environment and dependency boundaries.
stage_focus.implement: Fix the confirmed cause with the smallest complete change; never hide it behind an unrelated guard, retry or fallback.
stage_focus.verify: Re-run the original reproduction, add a regression test that fails before the fix, and test affected callers and adjacent contracts. A passing isolated helper test or suppressed exception is not proof.
stage_focus.inspect: Map the affected feature's entry point, callers/callees, shared state, configuration, dependency versions and adjacent tests before isolating the failure. Keep the map proportional, but do not inspect only the crashing function.

verify: the original reproduction now passes in the target environment or the limitation is explicitly recorded
a regression test fails before the fix and passes after it
the first divergence/root cause is supported by code, logs, trace or runtime evidence
failed attempts are not repeated; disproven hypotheses and changed investigation scope are recorded
affected callers, downstream behavior and important failure paths remain correct
the fix did not hide the failure with broad exception handling, retries or fallback behavior

strategies.name: Feature implementation
strategies.matches: New capability: a new endpoint, command, handler, screen, option or module that the project does not have yet.
when: the request asks for something that does not exist yet
existing interfaces can be extended rather than rewritten
acceptance criteria can be stated or inferred

stage_focus.inspect: Map the existing architecture around the extension point: entry points, callers, data ownership, shared services, dependency versions, contracts and tests. Search for existing implementations before creating new ones.
stage_focus.plan: Define acceptance criteria and a compact integration map: changed modules, data/API contracts, compatibility constraints, failure behavior and tests that prove composition with existing features.
stage_focus.implement: Extend the established architecture at its intended seam. Reuse existing services and conventions; avoid parallel paths, duplicate dependencies and speculative abstractions.
stage_focus.verify: Test acceptance criteria, invalid input, failure behavior and integration with existing callers/consumers. Verify public contracts and relevant regression paths, not only the new function in isolation.

verify: acceptance criteria are demonstrated against the real integration path
the chosen extension point and affected modules match the existing architecture
callers, data/API contracts and compatibility are checked
invalid input and failure paths behave correctly
existing behavior and adjacent integrations remain intact

strategies.name: Refactoring
strategies.matches: Restructure without behavior change: extract, rename, reorganize modules, untangle duplication, modernize patterns.
when: behavior is explicitly required to stay the same
structure, not function, is what the user wants improved
tests exist or can be pinned down before moving anything

stage_focus.inspect: Map callers, implementations, registrations, dynamic references, data contracts and tests before moving or deleting code. Establish the behavior baseline first.
stage_focus.plan: Sequence the moves so the project stays working after every step.
stage_focus.implement: Make bounded structural changes while preserving the mapped contracts; remove code only after references and indirect usage are checked.
stage_focus.verify: Run behavior-pinning tests and search for stale imports, registrations, references and compatibility breaks after the refactor.

verify: behavior checks are identical before and after
no unrelated redesign got mixed in
public interfaces kept compatible unless asked otherwise
dynamic references, registrations and downstream consumers are checked before removal

strategies.name: Architecture analysis
strategies.matches: Understand and assess how the system fits together: module boundaries, data flow, dependency direction, coupling, scaling limits, a written review or diagram.
when: the deliverable is an assessment or a design, not only code
the question is system-level: boundaries, flow, growth, risk
a migration, split or rewrite is being considered

stage_focus.inspect: Trace real paths end to end: entry points, data ownership, process and deployment boundaries. Evidence beats diagrams.
stage_focus.plan: Structure the analysis by question: what exists, what breaks first, what the options cost.
stage_focus.report: Separate observed facts from inference, and give recommendations with their trade-offs and migration cost.

verify: every claim traces to code, config or a measured run
assumptions are labelled as assumptions
recommendations name costs, not only benefits

strategies.name: Security review
strategies.matches: Find and fix vulnerabilities: injection, auth flaws, secret handling, unsafe deserialization, access control, supply chain.
when: the user asks for a security audit, hardening or vulnerability analysis
untrusted input reaches powerful sinks
authentication, authorization or secret storage is in scope

stage_focus.inspect: Enumerate trust boundaries: where untrusted data enters, where it is validated, where credentials live, what each principal may do.
stage_focus.diagnose: For each suspected flaw, construct the concrete exploit path or demonstrate it is blocked. No theoretical findings without a path.
stage_focus.implement: Fix at the boundary, not by patching one call site; prefer the platform's standard defense over a hand-rolled one.
stage_focus.verify: Show the exploit path is closed with a test that fails before the fix and passes after; confirm no authorized behavior broke.

verify: each finding has a concrete path or is rejected with evidence
fixes do not break legitimate authorized use
no secrets entered source, logs or the report

strategies.name: Performance optimization
strategies.matches: Make it faster or lighter: latency, throughput, memory, startup time, database load, battery, bundle size.
when: a measurable symptom exists or a budget was stated
hot paths, allocation, I/O or query patterns are suspected
scaling behavior matters more than micro-tuning

stage_focus.diagnose: Measure before optimizing: reproduce the workload, profile, and identify the dominant cost. Optimize what dominates or do nothing.
stage_focus.implement: One change per measurement cycle; algorithmic and I/O wins come before micro-tuning.
stage_focus.verify: Compare before and after on the same workload and report real numbers, including the variance.

verify: before and after numbers come from the same measured workload
no correctness, error handling or cleanup was traded away
the improvement holds under realistic data sizes

strategies.name: API integration
strategies.matches: Consume or expose an API: REST, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party SDKs, pagination, auth flows, rate limits, error mapping.
when: the task connects this project to an external or internal API
requests, schemas, auth, retries or pagination are involved
an integration is failing in production or a new one is planned

stage_focus.inspect: Identify the exact API and installed client distribution/version. Fetch official, version-matched API documentation and inspect the matching repository tag/source, examples, tests and changelog. Confirm every import, endpoint, schema, method and argument against the package installed in the target runtime; do not code from model memory or unversioned latest docs.
stage_focus.implement: Handle auth, pagination, timeouts, retries with backoff, rate limits and malformed responses; keep secrets in configuration, never in source or logs.
stage_focus.verify: Verify the API contract and package version against official docs for the installed release and the actual installed module/signatures; exercise behavior against fixtures or a mock. A live call only when authorized, with a timeout and one bounded attempt.

verify: package and client version, endpoint, method and schema confirmed against official version-matched documentation
imports and signatures confirmed against the actual installed package/source
timeout, retry, rate limit and error mapping all have explicit behavior
no secret appears in code, config samples or logs

strategies.name: Database engineering
strategies.matches: Schema changes, migrations, query work, indexes, transactions, connection handling, data backfill or cleanup.
when: tables, columns, constraints or indexes are created or changed
queries are slow, wrong or unbounded
data must be moved, backfilled or cleaned

stage_focus.inspect: Read the actual schema, indexes, migration history and data shape; measure the real query plan before judging it.
stage_focus.plan: Design migrations that are reversible or at least staged, and state the downtime and lock impact before running anything.
stage_focus.implement: Parameterized queries, bounded batches, explicit transactions; no N+1 reads, no unbounded writes.
stage_focus.verify: Prove the migration on a copy of realistic data, including rollback; destructive or production changes only with explicit approval.

verify: migration and its rollback proven on realistic data
no unbounded query, N+1 pattern or missing index on the hot path
production data touched only after explicit approval

strategies.name: Telegram bot development
strategies.matches: Building or fixing Telegram bots and userbots: handlers, filters, callbacks, sessions, FloodWait, media flows, bulk automation.
when: Pyrogram, Telethon, Bot API or a fork is in the stack
message handlers, media groups, file transfers or bot commands are involved
automation pipelines download, rename, encode or upload media

stage_focus.inspect: Identify the exact Telegram library distribution, fork, version, import path and session type. Fetch the official docs for that version and inspect the matching fork/upstream tag, exported symbols, signatures, examples, tests and changelog. Verify the installed package source before relying on Pyrogram or another fork's API; trace handler registration order and filter overlap, then follow the complete update-to-response path.
stage_focus.diagnose: For media problems, follow the whole flow: download, process, metadata, caption, thumbnail, upload, edit. An isolated function is rarely the cause.
stage_focus.implement: Preserve file IDs, thumbnails, captions, dimensions, duration, MIME type, grouping and ordering unless the task changes them. Handle FloodWait with the server's own wait time, bounded retries and explicit peer resolution.
stage_focus.verify: Test single item, bulk, missing metadata, duplicate delivery, partial failure and recovery. Confirm imported symbols and method signatures against the installed fork and version-matched official docs; never test against production chats.

verify: the exact library/fork and installed version are identified
imports, method signatures and parameters match the installed fork/source and its versioned docs
captions, thumbnails and media metadata survive the full flow
FloodWait, retries and duplicate updates are handled with bounds
handler order and filter overlap checked against the real update types

strategies.name: Media processing pipeline
strategies.matches: FFmpeg, FFprobe, aria2, yt-dlp, rclone, qBittorrent work: download, convert, encode, extract metadata, stream, move large files.
when: audio, video, image or subtitle files are transformed or transported
pipeline stages feed each other and must survive interruption
large files, temporary storage or disk ceilings are involved

stage_focus.inspect: Probe real inputs with ffprobe or equivalent: codecs, dimensions, duration, streams, bitrates. Never assume a container's contents.
stage_focus.plan: Design for interruption: stage to temporary files, atomic renames, resumable downloads, bounded disk usage, cleanup on failure.
stage_focus.implement: Stream or bounded-buffer; never load a large media file whole into memory. Set explicit timeouts and concurrency limits.
stage_focus.verify: Verify outputs by probing them, not by trusting exit codes: container, streams, duration, metadata and playable head and tail.

verify: output probed and playable, not just exit code zero
interrupted runs resume or clean up, never leave half-written outputs
disk and memory stay bounded on the largest expected input

strategies.name: Deployment troubleshooting
strategies.matches: Works locally, broken in deployment: Docker, VPS, platform hosting, reverse proxies, ports, environment, build systems, health checks.
when: the difference between environments is the problem
build, startup, networking or platform configuration is involved
logs show crashes, refused connections or wrong versions

stage_focus.inspect: Trace build artifact to image to startup command to environment to port binding to proxy routing. Compare configured values with actual ones.
stage_focus.diagnose: Read the real logs from the failing environment; reproduce locally or in staging before proposing a fix.
stage_focus.verify: Verify in the target environment, including restart and health checks; a local pass is not proof.

verify: health check green in the target environment after a restart
environment variables, ports and paths confirmed where the process actually runs
no production restart or migration without explicit authorization

strategies.name: Frontend engineering
strategies.matches: UI work: components, state, forms, routing, accessibility, responsive behavior, API wiring, loading and error states.
when: components, pages or client state are built or fixed
rendered output differs from expected behavior
data fetching, caching or form handling is involved

stage_focus.inspect: Trace the component path: state, events, requests, store updates, render. Follow the project's existing design tokens and conventions.
stage_focus.implement: Cover loading, empty, error and success states; keep the accessible semantics the framework gives you; do not redesign unrelated UI.
stage_focus.verify: Exercise the real interaction: keyboard, focus, slow network, failed request and empty data.

verify: loading, empty, error and success states all behave
keyboard and focus behavior preserved or added
no unrelated visual or layout changes

strategies.name: Scraping and data extraction
strategies.matches: Fetch and extract data: HTTP clients, HTML parsing, JSON APIs, pagination, sessions, async fetching, deduplication, storage.
when: data must be pulled from websites or services the user has legitimate access to
parsing, normalization, deduplication or export pipelines are involved
pagination, sessions or rate limits are in play

stage_focus.inspect: Confirm the access method is permitted and authorized: target, scope, terms, credentials. Respect robots, rate limits and access controls.
stage_focus.plan: Finite pages, bounded concurrency, explicit stop conditions; parse from saved fixtures before any live request.
stage_focus.implement: Finite timeouts, conservative pacing, bounded response sizes, validation and deduplication at the storage boundary.
stage_focus.verify: Parse real saved fixtures first; then a small live run with limits before any bulk run.

verify: parsing proven against saved real fixtures
timeouts, pacing, concurrency and stop conditions all bounded
access is authorized; nothing exceeded the permitted scope

strategies.name: Behavior-preserving reimplementation
strategies.matches: A reference repository or existing implementation is supplied and the user wants the same required functionality or logic reproduced in another project, codebase or language, preferably with a cleaner and more idiomatic design.
when: the user asks to make a feature work the same as a supplied repository or reference implementation
the source implementation contains unnecessary complexity, debugging leftovers or conventions that should not be copied blindly
behavior, interfaces, data formats or edge cases must remain compatible while the implementation is rebuilt

stage_focus.inspect: Trace the reference implementation from its entry points through callers, dependencies, configuration and tests. Identify observable behavior, contracts, side effects, data formats and edge cases; inspect exact dependency/fork versions and official docs where relevant.
stage_focus.diagnose: Separate required behavior from incidental implementation choices, duplication, dead code, temporary debugging and historical workarounds. Confirm what must be preserved instead of assuming every source-code detail is intentional.
stage_focus.plan: Create a compact behavior-parity matrix for normal inputs, edge cases, errors, side effects and compatibility. Map each requirement to a target implementation point and a verification case.
stage_focus.implement: Rebuild the behavior using idiomatic patterns and architecture in the target project. Preserve required contracts and safeguards, but do not line-translate or copy needless layers, debug scaffolding, dead code or accidental complexity. Prefer the smallest readable complete design, not a line-count target.
stage_focus.verify: Run parity tests for each behavior-matrix item, including important failure paths. Use reference fixtures or safe differential tests where possible; verify formatting, lint and types using the target project's configured tools.

verify: the required observable behavior and public contracts match the reference
normal inputs, edge cases, side effects and error behavior have parity coverage
the target implementation is idiomatic, readable and no more complex than the requirement needs
no temporary debugging code, dead paths, accidental dependencies or needless wrappers remain
formatting and relevant lint, type and test checks pass

strategies.name: Complex multi-stage project
strategies.matches: Several subsystems change together: feature plus migration plus deployment, protocol changes across services, multi-session builds.
when: no single strategy covers the whole task
the work spans days, sessions or subsystems
an integration boundary between in-repo and external parts must hold

stage_focus.classify: Split the work into independently verifiable phases and pick the best strategy for each phase as you reach it.
stage_focus.plan: Milestones are mandatory; each one ends in a state another session could take over.
stage_focus.implement: Keep the state file current after every milestone; treat it as the handoff contract.
stage_focus.verify: Verify each milestone on its own before building on it; integration checks ride on top, not instead.

verify: each milestone verified before the next starts
state file accurate enough to resume from cold
integration boundaries tested with both sides in place

strategies.name: Code review
strategies.matches: Judge someone else's change: a diff, a pull request, a candidate implementation, or two competing approaches to one task.
when: the deliverable is an assessment of existing code
candidate solutions must be compared and one chosen
a change is about to merge and needs a decision

stage_focus.inspect: Read the diff with its surroundings: callers, tests, config the code assumes. Never review a diff in isolation.
stage_focus.evaluate: Score with the rubric command using the change's own strategy when it maps to one. Report concrete findings with file, line, impact and evidence.
stage_focus.report: Separate blocking findings from preferences; say plainly which is which and what would change the verdict.

verify: every finding carries file, location and concrete impact
claimed bugs are demonstrated or clearly labelled unverified
no style preference reported as a defect
